issues.what: different plant structure: a has a compact bushy crown of many broad leaves on short petioles with a curved, slender stem; b has a tall, straight, thick stem with fewer, sparser, droopier leaves arranged in widely spaced pairs and a narrow pointed apex reaching near the top frame edge. A viewer would not call them the same plant
issues.fix: rebuild the plant to a's silhouette: slender slightly curving stem, dense crown of ~8 upward-angled ovate leaves clustered in the upper half, top near y≈95 of 788, overall height and width as in a

issues.where: field behind the plant (left and right midground)
issues.what: a has dense rows of seedling plants filling the midground on both sides, glistening wet; b has mostly bare dark soil with a few sparse grass tufts and blurred tall plants only near the horizon
issues.fix: fill the midground with rows of out-of-focus young leafy plants like a, crowding both sides behind the stem

issues.what: a has very dark, wet, clumpy tilled soil with specular highlights and a broad puddle with splashing droplets catching light at bottom center; b's soil is a smoother, lighter, dry-looking matte surface and the water is a narrow winding stream with no splashes
issues.fix: darken and roughen the soil into wet clods with glints, widen the water into a reflective puddle under and left of the plant with impact splashes

issues.what: a's leaves are rim-lit with a warm, soft glow from the bright horizon and show translucency; b has a cold, hard white fringe of hairs outlining every edge and the stem looks like a fuzzy, CG-shaded tube; leaf surfaces are flatter grey-green
issues.fix: reduce the white hair fringe to a fine soft rim, add translucent backlit glow through leaf edges, slender smooth stem with subtle fine hairs as in a

issues.what: a has a visible tree line and rolling hills under a bright glowing cloud band, with clear atmospheric haze; b's horizon band is dimmer and narrower, the hills are a faint dark smear, and the bright glow sits lower and smaller behind the plant
issues.fix: raise and widen the bright horizon band across the frame, restore the soft hazy hill and tree line silhouette

issues.what: a's sky is a smooth, heavy, dark teal overcast with dense fine rain streaks; b's sky has distinct puffy, mottled cloud shapes with more blue-grey contrast and rain streaks that are larger, sparser, and more uniform
issues.fix: flatten the cloud texture into soft overcast gradient, increase density and fineness of rain streaks

issues.what: b is cooler and more desaturated blue-grey with lifted shadows in the soil; a has deeper blacks in the soil and a slight warm cast at the horizon
issues.fix: crush soil blacks, warm the horizon highlights slightly, keep greens richer

issues.what: b's midground blur is smoother/CG with fewer bokeh highlights from droplets than a
issues.fix: add sparkling out-of-focus droplet highlights in the midground
